text: dsh-git-ui 是面向 DSH Web 会话的 Git 状态与工作记录界面插件。它在会话标题区域加入状态胶囊，并提供详情弹窗和 Git 中心。用户可查看分支、工作区变更计数、领先落后状态、提交历史、文件差异及按会话归集的工作记录，也可执行暂存、撤销暂存、丢弃变更和分支操作。适合希望在 DSH Web 中直接了解并管理当前会话仓库的开发者；需要运行 DSH Web，并由宿主提供 Git 子进程服务。

dsh-git-ui adds a Git status pill to DSH Web sessions, opening a popover and Git center. View branches, change counts, commits, diffs, and session work records; stage, unstage, discard changes, or manage branches. It requires DSH Web with Git subprocess access.
想在 DSH Web 会话标题里直接看到当前 Git 分支和改动数量。
有没有办法在 DSH 里快速确认本地分支领先或落后远端多少？
我想从会话界面查看最近提交和每个文件的差异。
让 DSH 能在网页里暂存文件、撤销暂存或丢弃改动。
想在不离开 DSH 的情况下切换或新建 Git 分支。
如何查看某一轮 agent 会话具体改了哪些文件？
Show the current repository branch and working-tree changes in my DSH web session.
I want to browse commits and inspect file diffs without leaving the harness.
dsh-git-ui 的功能「会话 Git 状态」：在 Web 会话标题显示当前分支及工作区状态，点击胶囊可打开详情弹窗查看仓库路径、变更计数和近期提交。状态按当前会话的工作目录读取。
dsh-git-ui 的功能「提交历史」：在 Git 中心的历史页浏览提交、筛选并查看提交详情；从 pill 点选近期提交也可跳转定位。
dsh-git-ui 的功能「文件差异」：在变更页查看工作区文件差异，也可从历史提交的文件树跳转到该提交对应的文件差异。
dsh-git-ui 的功能「变更与分支操作」：通过管理操作处理 Git 变更，执行结果会反馈成功提示或错误信息；具体操作由 host action 端点执行。
dsh-git-ui 的功能「Turn 工作记录」：Git 中心提供记录页，按会话展示 agent 工作轮次相关的文件变动记录；记录查询由 host 端点接入。

A Git status visualizer for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) (dsh) Web UI — a session-header pill, a detail popover, and a full Git center. No terminal needed.

> Read this in [简体中文](README.zh.md)

dsh-git-ui README · dsh-git-ui：- 📦 **npm**: <https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-git-ui>
- 🐙 **GitHub**: <https://github.com/Julyves/dsh-git-ui>
- 🐛 **Issues**: <https://github.com/Julyves/dsh-git-ui/issues>

dsh-git-ui README · At a glance：- **Pill** — branch · dirty counts (`+N −N ?N`) · ahead/behind at a glance
- **Popover** — recent commits, changed files, branch operations, one click from the pill
- **Git center** — four tabs: **History** (the landing tab), **Changes**, **Records**, **Settings**

dsh-git-ui README · Session-header pill & detail popover：A status capsule in each session header. Click it for the detail popover — repository root, status counts, recent commits, changed files with inline stage / unstage / discard, and branch operations:

dsh-git-ui README · Session-header pill & detail popover：| State | Pill |
|---|---|
| Clean | `● main` |
| Dirty | `● main · +2 −1 ?3` |
| Ahead / behind | `● main · ↑1 ↓2` |
| Detached HEAD | `● (detached HEAD) · a1b2c3d` |
| Not a git repo | Dimmed `无 Git 仓库` |

dsh-git-ui README · Session-header pill & detail popover：- **Recent commits** — click one to jump into the History tab, auto-located and selected
- **Changed files** — click a file to open its diff in the Changes tab; stage / unstage / discard inline
- **Branch switcher & create** — switch or create-and-switch without leaving the popover
- **Gear icon** — straight to Settings; the popover's section **order is customizable** there

dsh-git-ui README · Git center：Opened from the popover — the center keeps all four tabs mounted, so selections, filters and scroll positions survive tab switches. **History is the default landing tab.**

dsh-git-ui README · History：A paginated commit list with a rendered branch graph — windowed rendering keeps thousands of rows smooth, and the selected row lights up with a glowing track (cyber-style, reduced-motion aware):

dsh-git-ui README · History：- **Filter tree** — branches / tags / author / date / text-or-hash; prefixed branch groups (`feat/*`, `fix/*`, remote origins) start **collapsed** for a tidy list; a **fetch** button syncs remote refs
- **Date filter** — `今天` means **today since local midnight** (not the last 24 h); `24 小时内` and 7/30/90-day ranges are separate options
- **Search** — text or hash prefix with a one-click **clear** button

dsh-git-ui README · History：Selecting a commit shows its subject · body · changed-file tree (foldable, status-colored). Clicking a file in the tree jumps to the **Changes tab and shows that file's diff as of that commit**, marked by a commit-hash badge:
dsh-git-ui README · Changes：IDE-style groups (staged / unstaged / untracked), per-file & bulk stage / unstage / discard (two-step confirm), and a commit box: The diff viewer:

dsh-git-ui README · Changes：- **View modes** — `对照` (side-by-side, default) / `变更前` / `变更后`; the split divider is **draggable** (20%–80%)
- **Markdown rendering** — `.md` files get a `渲染` mode: formatted headings, lists, tables and fenced-code highlighting; `mermaid` diagrams render natively (with a source/rendered toggle and a clear parse-error fallback)
- **New / deleted files** — pure-add and pure-delete diffs render the full file content in a single column, with a `新增` / `已删除` badge
- **Syntax highlighting & context folding** — tokenized once per file, foldable long unchanged runs
dsh-git-ui README · Records：Turn work records answer "**what did this round touch, and who touched it**":

dsh-git-ui README · Records：- **Pill badge** — unread `new N` plus three-way counts: `本` this session's agent · `会` other sessions' AI · `外` human edits
- **Working-period timeline** — consecutive turns merge into period cards with the **task narrative**, time window and three-way file groups (still dirty / committed / reverted / gone); periods with no output stay expandable with a `无变更产出` mark
- **Actions** — bulk-stage "AI changes" or everything; committed entries **deep-link to the exact commit** in History, auto-located
- **Confidence & correction** — authoritative entries get solid badges, heuristic ones dashed `≈`; hover and press `⇄` to reclassify authorship (persisted per repository)
- **New-output marking** — each turn's boundary fingerprint marks this round's entries `新`

dsh-git-ui README · Settings：Display presets (minimal / standard / full, purely derived — tweaks snap back when they match a preset again), per-component switches for pill and popover, popover **section ordering**, and diff-viewer options:

dsh-git-ui README · Settings：- **Pill vs popover** — independent switches, including the work-record **badge** (pill) and the work-record **section** (popover), controlled separately
- **Popover sections** — reorder with up/down arrows; hidden sections stay in the sequence and appear at their position when enabled
- **Diff viewer** — code font size, syntax highlight, context folding; `最近提交` count (0 = hidden)

dsh-git-ui README · Installation：Requires a running [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) with the `web` profile:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-git-ui
```

Restart dsh web. Open a session in a git repository and the pill appears in the header. Remove with `dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-git-ui`.

> Local development install: `dsh plugin --profile web add ./` links this repo.
> Keep the dev peer symlinks in `node_modules/@deepseek-ai/*` (see [Development](#development)).

dsh-git-ui README · Usage：1. Open a session whose working directory is inside a git repository.
2. Read the pill any time — no action needed.
3. Click the pill to inspect counts, recent commits and changed files; open the Git center for full management.

Each session shows the status of **its own working directory**; non-repository sessions show a dimmed placeholder.

dsh-git-ui README · Configuration (optional)：All defaults work out of the box. Advanced users may override the plugin config in the profile's `cordis.patch.yml`:

```yaml
- id: git-ui
  config:
    defaultRefreshIntervalMs: 60000   # polling interval (ms); 0 disables polling
    maxChanges: 200                   # max changed-file entries in a snapshot

dsh-git-ui README · Requirements：- Node.js `^22.19.0 || >=24.0.0`
- dsh `>= 0.1.0-rc` (developer preview)
- `git` on the host machine

dsh-git-ui README · Known limitations：- Shows the session's working directory only; push / pull / merge are not exposed.
- Refresh is polling-based (default 30 s); event-push via file watchers is planned.
- The changed-file list is capped (`maxChanges`), with spill-file recovery for oversized status output.
- The browser only ever sends a `sessionId` — the host resolves cwd and runs git with path guards.
- Turn records are heuristic for dynamically-constructed bash targets (`$(...)`, globs, `eval`) — they fall back to `外` with a visible `≈` mark; cold sessions are skipped; observation timelines are capped.
- Syntax highlighting ships a bundle-budget language subset; mermaid support covers flowchart / graph and sequenceDiagram subsets.

pnpm install

dsh-git-ui README · Link the host-provided peers so a local profile install resolves them:：mkdir -p node_modules/@deepseek-ai
for p in "$HOME"/.dsh/profiles/node_modules/@deepseek-ai/*; do
  ln -sfn "$p" "node_modules/@deepseek-ai/$(basename "$p")"
done
pnpm run typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm run build
dsh plugin --profile web add ./   # local install; restart dsh web to verify
```

dsh-git-ui README · Architecture：The plugin is layered to isolate the dsh platform behind a narrow adapter seam:

```mermaid
flowchart TB
    subgraph Biz["Business Layer — zero dsh imports"]
        HostBiz["src/host/ · core / actions / queries / parser"]
        ClientBiz["src/client/ · controller / GitPill / GitCenter"]

dsh-git-ui README · Architecture：- `src/contracts/` — the plugin's own stable interfaces, no dsh imports
- `src/host/` / `src/client/` — business logic against those interfaces
- `src/adapters/dsh/` — the **only** place importing `@deepseek-ai/*`; a dsh upgrade only changes here
